resources.string: Lighting availability can depend on ignition, ambient light, regional rules, lamp faults, or another active automatic mode. The driver remains responsible for appropriate exterior lighting.
The requested lamp circuit and controller must be available. Safety-related exterior changes require an unrestricted vehicle UX state.
This vehicle exposes no supported lighting controls.
Park the vehicle to change this lighting mode.
Observed lighting control visualisation, not a physical lamp diagnostic

string-array.name: vehicle_lighting_descriptions
string-array.item: Selects the supported headlight mode for visibility and conspicuity.
Selects high-beam operation when it will not dazzle other road users.
Selects fog-lamp operation for supported low-visibility conditions.
Flashes all turn indicators to warn other road users of a stationary hazard.
Selects the general interior cabin-light mode.
Selects the reading-light mode for the chosen occupant zone.
Selects illumination of supported steering-wheel controls.
Selects low-level footwell illumination for the chosen seat zone.
